opening.argument: The video promotes OneCoin package sales through recruitment, promising percentage-based rewards when people join and when recruited networks generate activity. It describes a 10% direct-sales bonus and network compensation extending below the participant, while the bonus table displays rewards across four generations. It also presents daily points tied to investment packages and exchangeable for consumer rewards. The speaker forecasts a rise to 5 euro and a conditional outcome of 1,200,000 EUR after the third year, then urges viewers to contact the person who shared the video and invest promptly. The price scenarios are forecasts dependent on member involvement, and the presentation acknowledges that buyers could lose money, but those qualifications do not undo the solicitation.
